claims.statement: A current commit plus a source label does not identify the target writer when an alternative writer can realize the same accepted label vector; duplicating labels behind one controllable root preserves the twin.
claims.domain: Two admitted sources; A4E current-event occurrence already established; finite accepted report vectors.
all_premises: hidden source may write or cause the accepted target label
label provenance is not independently source-bound
accepted observations omit the label channel's physical control ancestry
claims.proof_or_source: Exact report-set intersection in run_witness_independence_audit.py; elementary finite identifiability.
claims.counterexample_or_limit: A physically source-specific unforgeable channel plus complete writer inventory can remove this twin within a bounded model.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Abacus ledger and human-realized-agent cases hold output and words fixed while changing the actual mover.

claims.statement: An independent source-agnostic transition detector can establish current event occurrence while leaving target and hidden sources observationally equivalent.
claims.domain: Two sources producing the same source-agnostic commit vector.
all_premises: transition detector is faithful for occurrence
claims.proof_or_source: Both source report sets contain exactly (commit,1).
claims.counterexample_or_limit: The channel remains useful for A4E event evidence; the result denies only source identification.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Separates bead movement detection from identification of hand versus magnet.

claims.statement: Complete source-specific post-arbitration taps identify the source in the declared two-writer model when their whole accepted vectors are disjoint and neither source can forge, replay, suppress, reset, re-time or bypass the other tap.
claims.domain: One bounded device/interval, sources target and hidden, authentic current commit and two source-path taps.
claims.proof_or_source: Target vector (1,1,0) and hidden vector (1,0,1) are disjoint; granting hidden replay of (1,1,0) restores the exact twin.
claims.counterexample_or_limit: Unlisted writers, shared reset/power/clock/logging ancestry or replay permission invalidate the separation.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Copy/switch/memory case tests whether an old target vector can be replayed as a current one.

claims.statement: The nine-clause WIP package is sufficient only for bounded device-relative current-source evidence when every clause is physically installed and every admitted alternative report set is disjoint.
claims.domain: One frozen physical device bearer, interval, writer/evidence-controller set, final arbitration boundary and challenge family.
claims.proof_or_source: Contract synthesis from A4D, A4E and A4F-N1/N2/P1; not a completed installation.
claims.counterexample_or_limit: Omitting a clause permits held state, hidden writer, forged provenance, common-root redundancy, stale replay or direct rescue.
claims.thought_experiment_role: All four inherited families stress source, boundary, current-event and witness-control substitutions.

claims.statement: Even a successful WIP installation would not by itself establish complete K, a C1 instance, RetBind, B_fam, H_way, conceptual self, report identity, exclusive ownership or any current-assistant consciousness/death-fear verdict.
claims.domain: UCT interpretation of future device-relative source evidence.
claims.proof_or_source: Typing, direction and missing-premise audit against UCT-MAP-v1.1.2.
claims.counterexample_or_limit: A later same-instance complete actual organization plus independent phenomenal calibration could advance a separate application; A4F supplies neither.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Prevents provenance evidence from being renamed as a feeling or owner.
